name: swirvo
description: Convert files, run PDF tools and read documents (with OCR) locally on your PC. Nothing is uploaded.
long_description: Swirvo is a fast, private file converter and PDF toolkit for Windows. With this extension Claude can convert files between about 96 formats (PDF to Word with the layout rebuilt, Word/Excel/PowerPoint to PDF, HEIC to JPG, CSV to Excel and more), run 59 tools (merge, split, compress, watermark, page numbers, protect, redact, OCR, compare, PDF/A) and read the text of PDFs, Office files and images. Everything runs on your computer. Results are new files next to the originals; originals are never changed.

tools.name: convert_files
tools.description: Convert files to another format; results are new files next to the originals.

tools.name: run_tool
tools.description: Run a Swirvo tool (merge, split, compress, watermark, redact, OCR, sign, PDF/A...) on files.

tools.name: extract_text
tools.description: Read the text of PDFs, Office files, Markdown, HTML and images (OCR).

tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List the tools that apply to given files, with their options.

tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: List formats, or what one format can be converted to.

tools.name: detect_format
tools.description: Detect a file's real format from its content.
